game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the cases value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the larder door using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The larder door reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the larder door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Chimney Roofs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Chimney Roofs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The larder door reached with actions_used <= 13.
